observations.behavior: Adds a new module, products/tasks/backend/run_options.py, with a RunSettings dataclass and several helper functions, including apply_run_options and run_options_record, which are used to convert TaskRunOptions into RunSettings and a dictionary, respectively.
observations.posthog_connection: This module is used to convert TaskRunOptions into RunSettings and a dictionary, which are used to configure the execution of a task. The github_read_access setting is used to determine whether the task has read access to GitHub.
